grades.quote: The fence also invalidates all address-translation cache entries matching the address space identified by integer register _rs2_ , except for entries containing global mappings.
grades.reason: Directly describes how SFENCE.VMA with an ASID in rs2 limits ordering and invalidation of cached address-translation entries to the matching address space. Global mappings are excluded from that invalidation.

grades.quote: The fence also invalidates all address-translation cache entries that contain leaf page table entries corresponding to the virtual address in _rs1_ and that match the address space identified by integer register _rs2_ , except for entries containing global mappings.
grades.reason: Covers the case where both the virtual address and the ASID are given: invalidation is limited to cached entries matching that address and ASID, and global mappings are excluded. It also covers ASID bit handling in rs2 (reserved bits, ASIDLEN/ASIDMAX) and says that stale translations may be used until a subsuming SFENCE.VMA.

grades.quote: Furthermore, for the common case that the translation data structures have only been modified for a single address-space identifier, _rs2_ can specify the address space.
grades.reason: Introduces SFENCE.VMA as the mechanism for invalidating the address-translation cache and says rs2 can select a single address space. The detailed ASID-specific cases are mostly in neighbouring passages. This one gives the general context and the all-address-spaces case.
